original:
Let $\Sigma$ be a connected loopless signed graph on $n\geq 2$ vertices with a balancing vertex.
Then the following conditions are equivalent:

(i) 

There exists an ordinary graph $G$ such that

 $\chi_{\Sigma}(q)=\chi_{G}(q),\qquad\text{equivalently,}\quad Z_{\Sigma}(q)=P_{G}(q).$ 

(ii) 

Every coefficient of $h_{\Sigma}(t)$ is nonnegative.

(iii) 

 $\Sigma$ has a balanced block.

(iv) 

 $Z_{\Sigma}(1)=0$ , equivalently, $\chi_{\Sigma}(2)=0$ .

Moreover, whenever these conditions hold, the graph $G$ can be chosen to be connected, simple, and to have $|V|$ vertices.

lemma x2611_16458_thm1_1_aux8 {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (P N : SimpleGraph V)

    (F : Finset (Sym2 V ⊕ Sym2 V))
    (hF : F ⊆ P.edgeFinset.disjSum N.edgeFinset)
    (hbot : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {e | Sum.inl e ∈ F} ⊔
      SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {e | Sum.inr e ∈ F} : SimpleGraph V) = ⊥) :
    F = ∅ := by
  classical
  apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro e he
  have hmem := hF he
  cases e with
  | inl e =>
    induction e using Sym2.ind with
    | _ v w =>
      have hp : P.Adj v w := by simpa using hmem
      have h : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {e | Sum.inl e ∈ F} ⊔
          SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {e | Sum.inr e ∈ F} : SimpleGraph V).Adj v w :=
        Or.inl ⟨he, hp.ne⟩
      simpa [hbot] using h
  | inr e =>
    induction e using Sym2.ind with
    | _ v w =>
      have hn : N.Adj v w := by simpa using hmem
      have h : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {e | Sum.inl e ∈ F} ⊔
          SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {e | Sum.inr e ∈ F} : SimpleGraph V).Adj v w :=
        Or.inr ⟨he, hn.ne⟩
      simpa [hbot] using h
